newsitem.title: POLAND: PPWK SETS NEW ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 12.
newsitem.headline: PPWK SETS NEW ISSUE PRICE AT PLN 12.

text.p: Polish map publisher Polskie Przedsiebiorstwo Wydawnictw Kartograficznych SA> (PPWK), listed on the bourse's parallel market, set its new issue price at 12 per share, the company said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that the decision was made on Monday by the management.

On Monday, ~Petrobank SA~bank and Eastbrokers Warszawski Dom Maklerski SA> brokerage agreed to underwrite 175,000 and 125,000 shares respectively from the issue for a fee of two percent of the value of underwritten shares.
Earlier in August, the Securities Commission gave the go-ahead to a one-for-two rights issue of PPWK.
The company plans to offer between 300,000 and 885,534 shares by subscription from September 23 to October 10 to shareholders of record as of September 10.
If not all the shares are subscribed, the leftover stock will be offered from November 4 to November 18.
The offering is mainly meant to raise funds to upgrade the firm's map-editing computer equipment and to buy new printing machines. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
